data.name: AlHishamah
data.gender_notes: AlHishamah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: She who is protected by Allah and His angels. The name AlHishamah carries the meaning “The Protected One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose AlHishamah usually hope their child will grow to embody the protected one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies being under Allah's protection and care
data.etymology: AlHishamah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Protected One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlHishamah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: الهيشمة
in_arabic.meaning: الهيشمة تعني الحماية أو الوقاية من الله
in_arabic.long_meaning: الهيشمة اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي ه-ش-م، ويعني الحماية أو الوقاية من الله. في اللغة العربية، الهيشمة هي الحماية الإلهية التي تحيط بالإنسان وتحفظه من كل سوء. وقد ورد هذا المعنى في القرآن الكريم في عدة آيات، منها قول الله تعالى: 'وَيُحَمِيَهُم مِّنَ السُّوءِ' (الآية 34 من سورة التوبة). يعتبر اسم الهيشمة من الأسماء ذات المعنى العميق في الإسلام، حيث يعبر عن الثقة بالله ورعايته.

in_urdu.name: الہیشمہ
in_urdu.meaning: الہیشمہ یعنی اللہ کی حفاظت یا احتیاط
in_urdu.long_meaning: الہیشمہ ایک عربی نام ہے جو جذر ہ-ش-م سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے اللہ کی حفاظت یا احتیاط. اردو میں، الہیشمہ کا مطلب ہے وہ تحفظ جو اللہ تعالیٰ اپنے بندوں کو عطا کرتا ہے. یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ اللہ کی رحمت اور محبت کا اظہار کرتا ہے. الہیشمہ نام رکھنے والوں کو اللہ کی حفاظت کا یقین ہوتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: अलहिशमाह
in_hindi.meaning: अलहिशमाह का अर्थ है ईश्वर की सुरक्षा या बचाव
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलहिशमाह एक अरबी नाम है जो मूल ह-श-म से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है ईश्वर की सुरक्षा या बचाव. इस नाम का अर्थ है ईश्वर द्वारा प्रदान की गई सुरक्षा और संरक्षण. अलहिशमाह नाम रखने वाले लोग ईश्वर की कृपा और सुरक्षा पर विश्वास करते हैं. इस नाम का महत्व इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत अधिक है.

in_pashto.name: الهيشمة
in_pashto.meaning: الهيشمة معنی یې د الله حفاظت یا خوندیتوب
in_pashto.long_meaning: الهيشمة د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی، چي د ه-ش-م جذر څخه مشتق دی، معنی یې د الله حفاظت یا خوندیتوب دی. په پښتو کې، الهيشمة د الله تعالی د رحم او حفاظت معنی لري. دا نوم په اسلامي کلتور کې د پام وړ دی، ځکه چې د الله د قدرت او پاملرنې څرګندونه کوي.

in_english.name: AlHishamah
in_english.meaning: AlHishamah means protection or preservation by Allah
in_english.long_meaning: AlHishamah is derived from the Arabic root h-sh-m, signifying protection or preservation by Allah. In Islamic tradition, AlHishamah represents the divine shield that safeguards believers from harm. This name reflects trust in Allah's providence and care. Historically, names like AlHishamah were chosen to invoke divine blessings and protection upon the bearer.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic history and society, the name AlHishamah serves as a reminder of the belief in the divine protection and guardianship of Allah and His angels. Naming a child with this name reaffirms the parents' faith and dedication to their belief, and the child grows up with a constant reminder of the security and safety that comes from trusting in Allah.
data.spiritual_significance: The name AlHishamah holds a deep spiritual significance, emphasizing the importance of seeking refuge in Allah and recognizing His presence in our lives. As Muslims, we believe that no harm can come to us without Allah's permission, and the name serves as a daily reminder of that faith. It also conveys the idea that we are never truly alone, as Allah and His angels are always with us, providing guidance and protection. Ultimately, the name AlHishamah is a powerful source of comfort, strength, and inspiration, reminding us to put our trust in Allah and stay steadfast in our faith.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "The Protected One" symbolizes She who is protected by Allah and His angels. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name AlHishamah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of the protected one.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Hishamah is mentioned in the works of Ibn Qutaybah (d. 889 AD) and Ibn Abi Dunya (d. 961 AD). The name AlHishamah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Al-Hishamah is mentioned in early Islamic literature as a name for a type of bird.

trends: Gaining popularity in Western Muslim communities
modern_usage.modern_context: The name AlHishamah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: Aisha AlHishamah from Istanbul, Turkey embodies the meaning of AlHishamah - "The Protected One". Growing up, they were known for their strong character and deep faith, always striving to live up to the beautiful significance of their name.
